chat.demo_note: Yeh chat wohi agent chalata hai jo dukaan ke WhatsApp par hai.
chat.error: Abhi nahi gaya. Dobara koshish ho rahi hai…
dashboard.title: Dashboard
receipt.title: Raseed check karein
trust.title: Trust page
agent.fallback: Maazrat, abhi jawab nahi de saka. Dukaan ke maalik jald jawab denge.
home.demo_note: Yeh dukaanein aur in ke gahak sirf demo ke liye banaye gaye hain.
chat.empty: Shuru karne ke liye salam kahein. Dukaan ka assistant usi zabaan mein jawab deta hai jis mein aap likhein.
dashboard.lede: Orders, approval ki muntazir payments, hisaab kitaab aur fraud alerts yahan dukaan ke maalik ke liye honge.
receipt.lede: Har Chatfront raseed par QR code hota hai. Usay scan karne se yeh page khulta hai aur batata hai ke raseed asli hai ya nahi.
trust.lede: Sirf yahan diye gaye zariye {shop} ke hain. Is ka naam istemal karne wala koi aur dukaan nahi hai.
trust.channels: Dukaan se rabte ke official zariye
link.whatsapp_greeting: Salam {shop}! Main ne aap ki dukaan Chatfront par dekhi.
landing.title: Poori dukaan, unhi chats mein jahan aap ke gahak pehle se hain.
landing.lede: Chatfront WhatsApp, Instagram aur Messenger par gahakon ko unhi ki zabaan mein jawab deta hai, order leta hai, aur har payment ka screenshot us raqam se milata hai jo waqai aayi.
demo.ask: Yeh lawn suit kitne ka hai?
demo.price: 3-piece Rs 4,850 ka hai. Transfer karein ge ya COD?
demo.matching: Bank SMS se milaya ja raha hai…
demo.receipt: Payment mil gayi. Aap ki raseed: CF-7K3P
proof.title: Jaali screenshot pass nahi ho sakta.
proof.lede: Chatfront screenshot parhta hai, phir dukaan ke apne phone par aaye credit SMS ko dekhta hai. Order tabhi paid mana jata hai jab raqam, transaction ID aur waqt teeno milein.
proof.arrived: Bank ka SMS kya kehta hai
proof.verdict: Teeno mil gaye: order paid ho jata hai aur signed raseed chali jati hai. Kuch bhi mukhtalif ho to maalik ko saboot ke saath Approve aur Reject ke button milte hain.
how.title: Chatfront par dukaan kaise chalti hai
how.1_body: Product naam, qeemat, size aur tafseel ke saath catalog mein aa jati hai.
how.2_title: Agent har chat mein bechta hai
how.2_body: WhatsApp, Instagram aur Messenger par, har gahak ki apni zabaan mein, aur kabhi maalik ki kam se kam qeemat se neeche nahi.
how.3_title: Raqam pehle check, phir hisaab mein
how.3_body: Payment bank SMS se milayi jati hai, raseed signed hoti hai, aur har sale khaate mein darj ho jati hai.
chat.queued: Server jaagte hi bhej diya jayega
wake.note: Free hosting khaali waqt mein so jati hai. Tab tak page chalta rehta hai.
lang.note: Beta: abhi live model ke saath test nahi hui. Tarjumay kisi ahl-e-zabaan ki jaanch ke muntazir hain.
owner.help: Main aap ki dukaan ka assistant hoon. Naya product daalne ke liye us ki photo bhejein, phir voice note ya likh kar naam aur qeemat batayein. Qeemat ya dukaan ki policy badalni ho to bas bata dein, jaise: "lawn 3-piece ab 2,500 ka hai".
owner.photo_received: Photo mil gayi. Ab is ka naam aur qeemat batayein, voice note mein ya likh kar.
owner.need_price: Qeemat kya hai? Aise likhein: Lawn suit 4850
owner.need_name: Is product ka naam kya hai?
owner.voice_unclear: Voice note samajh nahi aaya. Meharbani kar ke naam aur qeemat likh dein.
owner.in_stock: {count, plural, one {# stock mein} other {# stock mein}}
owner.product_added: {name} daal diya (code {code}). Ab yeh aap ke shop page par hai: {link}
owner.cancelled: Cancel kar diya. Kuch nahi badla.
owner.expired: Yeh request purani ho gayi. Dobara bhejein.
owner.changes_applied: {count, plural, one {Ho gaya: # tabdeeli save ho gayi.} other {Ho gaya: # tabdeeliyan save ho gayin.}}
owner.not_found: Aap ke products mein "{name}" nahi mila.
owner.which: Aap ka matlab kaunsa hai: {options}? Product ke code ke saath dobara bhejein.
owner.floor_above_price: {name} ki kam se kam qeemat us ki qeemat se zyada nahi ho sakti.
start.welcome: Assalam-o-alaikum! Chaliye chand minute mein aap ki dukaan banate hain. Dukaan ka naam kya hai, aur aap kya bechte hain?
start.ask_city: Aap kis shehar se bechte hain?
start.ask_delivery: Delivery kahan kahan karte hain, aur kitne din lagte hain?
start.ask_payment: Customer aap ko payment kaise karte hain? JazzCash, Easypaisa, bank transfer, Raast ya cash on delivery?
start.ask_products: Ab kisi product ki photo bhejein, naam aur qeemat ke saath. Jitne chahein bhejein, phir "bas" likh dein. Abhi "bas" likh kar products baad mein bhi daal sakte hain.
start.product_noted: Note kar liya: {name}, {price}. Agla bhejein, ya "bas" likh dein.
start.made:
Aap ki dukaan tayyar hai: {link}
Isay yahan se chalayein (yeh link kisi ko na dein): {owner_link}
start.trial_note: Website par bani hai, is liye yeh dukaan 7 din rakhi jayegi.
start.cancelled: Theek hai, ruk gaya. Jab chahein dobara salam kar ke shuru karein.
chat.mic_blocked: Mic band hai. Voice note bhejne ke liye is site ko mic ki ijazat dein.
chat.no_recording: Yeh browser voice note record nahi kar sakta. Likh kar bhejein ya photo bhejein.
chat.not_sent_type: Nahi gaya: yahan sirf photo aur voice note bheje ja sakte hain.
chat.not_sent_size: Nahi gaya: file 20 MB se bari hai.
catalog.empty: Abhi yahan koi product nahi. Chat mein poochein kya available hai.
shop.try_owner_title: Aisi dukaan chalate hain? Teen din ke liye chala kar dekhein
shop.try_owner_body: Is dukaan ki apni copy lein aur maalik ban kar istemaal karein: photo se product daalein, voice note se qeemat badlein, delivery ka waqt tay karein. Aap ki copy teen din baad mita di jati hai.
shop.try_owner_failed: Aap ki copy nahi ban saki. Ek minute baad dobara koshish karein.
make.title: Chat kar ke apni dukaan banayein
make.lede: Chand sawalon ke jawab dein, jo bechte hain us ki photos bhejein, aur taqreeban paanch minute mein aap ki dukaan ka page tayyar. Yahi chat WhatsApp par bhi chalti hai.
make.note: Chatfront ka apna assistant aap ki dukaan banata hai. Jab tak aap summary confirm na karein, kuch nahi banta.
make.empty: Shuru karne ke liye salam kahein.
console.title: Maalik ka console
console.demo_note: Yeh demo dukaan ki aap ki apni copy hai, aazmaane ke liye. Teen din baad mita di jayegi.
console.chat_note: Product daalne ke liye us ki photo naam aur qeemat ke saath bhejein. Koi tabdeeli likhein ya bol kar batayein, jaise "Lahore mein delivery 2 din mein hoti hai". Button dabane tak kuch nahi badalta.
console.chat_empty: Photo bhejein, ya assistant ko batayein kya badalna hai.
console.suggest_1: Aap kya kya kar sakte hain?
console.suggest_2: Poore Pakistan mein delivery 2 se 3 din mein hoti hai
console.suggest_3: Dukaan roz subah 11 se raat 10 baje tak khuli hai
console.no_products: Abhi koi product nahi. Chat mein photo naam aur qeemat ke saath bhejein.
console.by_model: Assistant ne likha hai. Zaroorat ho to theek karein.
console.name: Naam
console.save_failed: Save nahi hua. Dobara koshish karein.
console.expired: Yeh session khatam ho gaya hai. Apni dukaan ka link dobara kholein.
console.signed_out_body: Console us private link se khulta hai jo dukaan bante waqt aap ko mila tha. Abhi dukaan nahi? Chat kar ke banayein, ya koi demo dukaan maalik ban kar aazmaayein.
